note: DEV natural-language teaching templates (NL_TEACH_LANGUAGE_V1). Placeholders: {P} person, {T} time, {PL} place. Clauses are lower-case imperative verb phrases without final punctuation. 'A' = direct imperative, 'B' = lexical paraphrase. RETURN patterns have 'noun' (a type / result noun that uniquely identifies the referent) and 'pronoun' forms. LOCKED_TEST uses a disjoint file written independently.

find only those calls with {P} that are open

get the calls I have at {T}
look up the requests {P} made for {T}

get every open email going to {P}
